title: Color saturation and brightness effects on arousal and pleasure
statement:
Color saturation and brightness exert a much stronger influence on human emotional arousal and pleasure than the actual hue itself.

Options:
- High Arousal: High Saturation / High Brightness (fits: gaming, promotions)
- Calming / Relaxed: Low Saturation / High Brightness (fits: health tech, productivity)
- Dominance / Luxury: High Saturation / Low Brightness (fits: premium brands, fashion)
appliesWhen: Applies to: all digital products. Audience: general.
